rows.note: Use this for the common powdered chemical raising agent used in baking, especially baking powder.

example.english: When I bake a cake, I add a little leavening to make it fluffier.
example.traditional: 我整蛋糕嗰陣會加少少發粉，等佢鬆啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing2 daan6 gou1 go2 zan6 wui5 gaa1 siu2 siu2 faat3 fan2 dang2 keoi5 sung1 di1

rows.note: Use this when the leavening is yeast, which makes dough rise through fermentation.

example.english: You need to add leavening to make the dough rise when making bread.
example.traditional: 做麵包要落酵母，等麵團發起。
example.jyutping: zou6 min6 baau1 jiu3 lok6 haau1 mou5 dang2 min6 tyun4 faat3 hei2

rows.note: Use this as the general or technical term for a substance added to make dough or batter rise.

example.english: This leavening must first be mixed evenly with the flour.
example.traditional: 呢種膨脹劑要先同麵粉撈勻。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 paang4 zoeng3 zai1 jiu3 sin1 tung4 min6 fan2 lou1 wan4
